source: Owner answers pasted from the Hub's Questions tab (verbatim): grilling round 2.
raw:
purse_limit: No limit and no fix: rich Towns may hold 100k+  | note: Balance the game so it takes longer for them to reach that point. The point is for towns to trade goods between each other + residents to pay them a tax for those goods. Towns pay tax to the castle/kingdom when they buy/sell resources, but not when their residents use those resources, residents produce their own income to the town. So the way the town makes money is for supplying residents with items such as Hut with wood + potato and fish + wool for extra bonus. If wood/potato costs more gold(after tax) than resident is producing per wood/potato then the town is losing money.
price_range_scope: The whole asking price stays between 0.25× and 5× base, whatever the reason (Stock or Sales pressure)  | note: Town selling resource is the only one that determines what price to sell something at, they will buy w/e is available(if gold allows) for it from other towns.
price_curve_speed: Those numbers
price_graph_where: Only from the Goods strip (Kingdom average)  | note: Price for a specific item is global, but each town applies their own price on top based on how much is selling or not selling. So we want a graph on top left where we have list of resources, we click on it to expand details(I shared image earlier)
overview_open: A button only; K stays the Castle  | note: Give me a list of button shortcuts and I will tell you, but R for research, 1-4 for building buttons at the bottom and when any of them is open we can press 1-8 to choose a building. Also buildings should be shown horizontally in a list, not vertically and have an icon with a name and a gold cost. Tooltip that shows gold + resource cost on a building too)
overview_columns: Town, level, people per tier, happiness, Purse, Tax per minute, Tariff per minute it brings the Crown, what it makes most, what it lacks (missing Basic Needs), alerts
goods_strip: Only Goods the Kingdom has or makes; each chip shows the Good, the Kingdom's total Stock, the average price and a rising/falling arrow (over the chosen period)
resource_flow: Towns that make it (green ring), Towns that use it (orange ring), and lines along the trade routes it travelled in the last 5 minutes (thicker = more)  | note: Line should be visible to all connections that purchase that item from this town(or want to purchase or purchased recently, even if current stock is 0) Thicker line for connections that use more resources.
town_alerts: A Basic Need is missing; A workplace is idle (no workers or no inputs); Residents very unhappy (below 30%); A building can't be finished: no Town sells a material it needs; The Town's Purse is empty  | note: All of those icons should appear above a building that caused it, unhappy citizen is an exception and should be on a town itself, but empty workplace should be on the workplace or missing resource.

purse_limit.note: No purse limit. Balance so Towns take longer to get rich. Towns earn from residents, who pay the Town for the Goods they are supplied (Hut: wood + potato; fish + wool as a bonus). Towns pay Tariff to the Crown when they buy/sell, not when residents use Goods. A Town loses money when a Good costs it more (after Tariff) than its residents pay for it.
purse_limit.outcome: Purse limit to be removed; Tax and Tariff model re-asked in round 3.

price_range_scope.note: Only the selling Town sets the price; buyers buy whatever is available if they can afford it.
price_range_scope.outcome: Asking price clamped 0.25x-5x base overall; buyer choice re-asked in round 3.

price_curve_speed.outcome: Steady selling: ~2x after 5 min, ~3x after 30 min, ~4x after 2 h, never 5x. Unsold: 0.5x after 5 min, 0.25x after ~1 h.

price_graph_where.note: A Good's price is global; each Town applies its own adjustment on top. Graph in a top-left list of Goods; click a Good to expand its details (web-era design, TASKS.md 2026-07-08).
price_graph_where.outcome: Top-left Goods list with an expandable detail panel and price graph (1 min / 5 min / 30 min / all time).

overview_open.note: R research; 1-4 open the build tabs at the bottom; with a tab open, 1-8 picks a building. Build bar: horizontal list, icon + name + gold cost; tooltip with gold + material cost. Owner wants the full shortcut list to decide.
overview_open.outcome: Kingdom Overview opens from a button; K stays the Castle. Shortcut list asked in round 3.

goods_strip.outcome: Only Goods the Kingdom has or makes.

resource_flow.note: Lines to every Town that buys the Good from this Town, wants to, or bought recently (even if Stock is 0 now); thicker for bigger buyers.
resource_flow.outcome: Resource Flow: producer/consumer rings plus lines for every buyer connection.

town_alerts.note: Icons over the building that causes them (idle workplace on the workplace, missing resource on the building that lacks it); only unhappy residents (and an empty Purse) sit over the Town itself.
town_alerts.outcome: All five alerts; placed on the causing building.
